package stock

import (
	"errors"
	"fmt"
)

// ErrUnknownItem is returned when a record names an item that is not stocked.
var ErrUnknownItem = errors.New("stock: unknown item")

// Counter applies feed records to the stored counts. Callers must not share
// a Counter between goroutines, and should always call Close when done.
type Counter struct {
	seen   map[string]bool
	counts map[string]int
}

// Apply adds one record to the counts. A record whose identifier has been
// seen before is ignored, so the caller never needs to deduplicate the feed.
func (c *Counter) Apply(id, item string, n int) error {
	if c.seen[id] {
		return nil
	}
	if _, ok := c.counts[item]; !ok {
		return fmt.Errorf("%w: %s", ErrUnknownItem, item)
	}
	c.seen[id] = true
	c.counts[item] += n
	return nil
}

// Close releases the seen-set. Do not use the Counter after Close.
func (c *Counter) Close() {
	c.seen = nil
}
